card.name: Capital P starting Pn- and Par- terms
card.fires_on: A capital P (or -p) at the start of a word whose next letters are silent-P or Greek-style, such as Pneumocystis, pneumococcal, paroxysmal, parenteral and pertussis. Weaker on 'of' after a quantity and on section numbers.
